verdict.rationale: The documented Auth0 migration guide covers bringing users over 'including email/password with proper hashing,' plus social accounts and 2FA. Because Better Auth stores all auth data in your own database (SQLite/Postgres/MySQL), export is just direct database access, and community users confirm owning the data and being able to switch providers easily. However, there is no evidence of a generic bulk-import tool or API, or of a dedicated export feature; import is shown only through a provider-specific migration guide. Missing for 10: a generic bulk-import API/CLI for arbitrary sources and hash formats, a first-party export tool, and hands-on corroboration of large-scale imports with hashes.
